questions.question: What is the primary purpose of Registration Management in a 5G SA network?

answers.b: To provide authorized access to network services

explanations.a: Incorrect. Radio frequencies are managed by the RAN.
explanations.b: Correct. Registration Management authorizes UE access to the 5G network.
explanations.c: Incorrect. User-plane tunnels are handled after registration.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Charging is managed by separate functions.

questions.question: Which 5G Core Network Function terminates NAS signaling from the UE?

explanations.c: Correct. AMF terminates all NAS signaling.

questions.question: Which identifier protects the permanent subscriber identity over the air?

explanations.a: Incorrect. SUPI is the permanent identity.
explanations.c: Correct. SUCI conceals the SUPI during transmission.

questions.question: Which protocol carries NAS messages between the UE and gNB?

explanations.a: Incorrect. NGAP is used between gNB and AMF.
explanations.b: Correct. NAS messages are encapsulated within RRC.
explanations.d: Incorrect. SCTP is used on the N2 interface.

questions.question: Which NAS message initiates the registration procedure?

explanations.b: Incorrect. This is sent by the network.
explanations.c: Correct. Registration Request starts the procedure.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Authentication occurs after registration initiation.

questions.question: Which network function performs subscriber authentication?
What is established by the Security Mode Command?

explanations.a: Incorrect. Radio bearers are configured by RRC.
explanations.b: Correct. Security Mode Command activates NAS security.
explanations.c: Incorrect. User-plane tunnels are handled later.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Slicing policies are handled by AMF and PCF.

questions.question: Which identifier is assigned by the AMF to protect user privacy after registration?

explanations.d: Incorrect. TAI identifies a tracking area.

questions.question: What triggers a Mobility Registration Update?

answers.c: Movement to a new Tracking Area

explanations.c: Correct. Mobility updates occur when UE enters a new TAI.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Slice changes do not trigger mobility updates.

questions.question: Which interface is used between gNB and AMF?

explanations.a: Incorrect. N1 is logical UE-AMF signaling.
explanations.b: Correct. N2 connects gNB and AMF.
explanations.c: Incorrect. N3 connects gNB and UPF.
explanations.d: Incorrect. N6 connects UPF to data networks.

questions.question: Which data is retrieved from UDM during initial registration?

explanations.a: Incorrect. Radio configuration is handled by gNB.
explanations.b: Correct. UDM provides authentication and subscription data.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Traffic statistics are handled elsewhere.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Paging is managed by AMF.

questions.question: What does TAI stand for in the context of mobility?

explanations.a: Incorrect. This term is not defined in 5G.
explanations.d: Incorrect. This term does not exist in 5G.

questions.question: Which registration type is used when the UE has no valid registration context?

explanations.c: Correct. Initial registration is used without existing context.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Emergency registration is a special case.

questions.question: Which timer triggers Periodic Registration Update?

explanations.a: Incorrect. T300 is an RRC timer.
explanations.c: Incorrect. T3324 is used for idle mode behavior.
explanations.d: Incorrect. T3550 relates to session management.

questions.question: Which message confirms successful registration to the network?

explanations.a: Incorrect. This message is sent by the network.
explanations.c: Correct. Registration Complete finalizes the procedure.
explanations.d: Incorrect. This is part of authentication.
